title: MOTION (BLUMENFIELD - JURADO) and RESOLUTION relative to issuing, in an amount not to exceed $650,000,000 to finance and/or refinance all or a portion of…
text:
[Council File 26-1597; CD 3]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
MOTION (BLUMENFIELD - JURADO) and RESOLUTION relative to issuing, in an amount not to exceed $650,000,000 to finance and/or refinance all or a portion of the costs of, or reimbursing prior expenditures related to, the acquisition and/or construction, improvement, furnishing and equipping of capital projects at the Borrower's elder care facilities known as The Livelle (Project), located at and in the vicinity of 23200 West Mulholland Drive in Council District Three (CD 3).
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. CONSIDER the results of the Tax Equity and Fiscal Responsibility Act of 1982 (TEFRA) public hearing held on October 14, 2026 for the Project.
2. ADOPT the accompanying TEFRA RESOLUTION approving the issuance of bonds in an amount not to exceed $650,000,000 to finance and/or refinance all or a portion of the costs of, or reimbursing prior expenditures related to, the acquisition and/or construction, improvement, furnishing and equipping of capital projects at the Borrower's elder care facilities known as The Livelle (Project), located at and in the vicinity of 23200 West Mulholland Drive in CD 3.
